Because this entry is not officially confirmed, unit counts, tenure and that launch month are left out of the facts below, and no TOP or key date is confirmed. Please use the sale documents for typologies and completion. This page sets out what is on file and how to plan your Thomson Reserve renovation.

sections.heading: Planning your Thomson Reserve interior
sections.text:
In a large Thomson-belt condominium, unit types will vary, and neighbours will be fitting out on different calendars. What does not vary is the work that usually makes a new home liveable: an entry cabinet, a living-room joinery wall, full-height wardrobes, and a fitted kitchen with a tall pantry. If you have a study or a flexible common room, a built-in desk and wardrobe run is cleaner than a loose table. Maison designs those pieces as custom carpentry, not as flat-pack furniture, and we will not publish a typical layout for this estate because no official floor plan is on file. Send your approved plan and we will design to that drawing.

AMO Residence is already live on this site in District 20, and Lentor Gardens Residences sits just to the north in District 26. Those are nearby links for readers, not a shared typologies list or a shared management handbook. We will not invent walking times to Thomson, to Ang Mo Kio, or to any MRT station. Check your own stack, facing and the estate rules before you plan blinds, a balcony cabinet or a window bench, especially if your living room is long and open.

When a key date is in writing, leave time for defects inspection, measurement and renovation approval before fabrication. In a large development, contractor access and lift bookings can be busy; read the rules early. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial allowance only. WhatsApp Maison with your unit type and plan. We are not affiliated with the developer.
